news.headline: Delcath Systems Sets New 52-Week High as Analysts Lift Targets After Q2 Beat
news.summary: DCTH pushed to a fresh 52-week high above $17 as the post-earnings rally resumed, with BTIG lifting its target to $21 (from $17) and H.C. Wainwright to $32 (from $30), both Buy. Wall Street Zen upgraded to Buy and the consensus target moved to roughly $23, implying meaningful upside from current levels.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Amends Bylaws to Designate Delaware Courts as Exclusive Forum
news.summary: The board amended and restated Delcath's bylaws so that Delaware's Court of Chancery is the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims and U.S. federal courts for Securities Act claims. This is a routine governance update for a Delaware-incorporated company, recommended by the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee and not tied to any pending matter.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston
news.summary: Management presented to institutional investors in Boston days after the Q2 beat, using the slot to reinforce the HEPZATO KIT commercial-ramp story and the center-activation roadmap. Investor outreach at growth conferences has been a consistent part of the post-approval narrative build.

news.headline: Q2 Call: mCRC Phase 2 Now Screening at 13 Centers, Breast Cancer Program Advancing
news.summary: On the Q2 call management said the company-sponsored Phase 2 trial in metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening, with recruitment improving after site additions and specialized training. Management also pointed to independent ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate with percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026 Results: $29.1M Revenue Beats Estimates, Raises FY Guidance to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose to $29.1M from $24.2M a year earlier (HEPZATO KIT $27.1M, CHEMOSAT $2.0M) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, with gross margin expanding to 90% from 86% and EPS of $0.07 versus a consensus loss of $0.09. Delcath raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M, implying at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth, and reiterated its expectation of positive adjusted EBITDA for the year; the stock jumped over 20% on the print.

news.headline: Delcath Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 HEPZATO Trial for Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the roughly 90-patient randomized DELUMA trial (NCT06875128), testing HEPZATO plus standard of care in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer. It is the company's key pipeline expansion beyond ocular melanoma into a far larger addressable indication.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report is expected in early-to-mid November 2026 based on prior-year timing; no exact date has been announced. It is the first checkpoint on whether HEPZATO volume growth and center activations are tracking the raised full-year guidance.

catalysts.label: 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Delcath exited Q2 2026 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers and targets roughly 37 by year-end. Center count is the single most direct driver of near-term revenue, so the pace of the final activations is the key operational metric to watch.

catalysts.label: FY2026 guidance of $104M-$108M and positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025 with gross margin in the high 80s. Management also guided to positive adjusted EBITDA for the full year, which would mark the transition to a self-funding commercial model.

catalysts.label: mCRC Phase 2 enrollment progress
catalysts.detail: The company-sponsored Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening, with recruitment improving. Enrollment milestones and eventual data would open the largest liver-dominant indication in the pipeline.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 enrollment and data
catalysts.detail: The roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer began dosing in July 2026 and is enrolling across US and EU sites. Full enrollment and first efficacy readouts are the next major pipeline catalysts, supported by independent ESMO retrospective data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate.

pulse: Delcath is in the strongest stretch of its commercial story so far: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M beat estimates, gross margin hit 90%, the company swung to a per-share profit, and full-year guidance was lifted to $104M-$108M with positive adjusted EBITDA expected. The stock responded with a 20%+ single-day move and has since pushed to fresh 52-week highs above $17, with BTIG ($21), H.C. Wainwright ($32) and a Zacks upgrade to Strong Buy reinforcing the bullish sell-side tilt. The near-term narrative is execution-driven -- getting from 31 to 37 active HEPZATO centers by year-end and proving the guidance -- while the DELUMA breast cancer trial and the 13-center mCRC Phase 2 provide the longer-dated optionality beyond ocular melanoma.
